set.body: Part of Epic bd-01KWZ2GPT8TQV4J75CBXYKHT0S. Scope: add inspectable OLS diagnostics for solve method, rank, predictor count, tolerance policy, and any rank/conditioning failure surface that callers need. Acceptance: Dense/Runwise/GLS result paths can report the OLS solver used where applicable; diagnostics remain cross-platform and typed; fitJVM/test and fitJS/test pass.
set.title: LS hardening: expose OLS solver diagnostics
